proposals.old_text: You are a text generation assistant. Given a topic and constraints, produce the requested output. Follow all constraints exactly.
proposals.new_text: You are a text generation assistant. Given a topic and constraints, produce the requested output. Follow all constraints exactly, including format and avoiding unrelated content.
proposals.hypothesis: Adding explicit mention of format adherence and avoiding unrelated content directly addresses both failure patterns by making these requirements more salient.
proposals.expected_improvement: Reduction in cases where output ignores format (gen-004, gen-006, gen-007, gen-011) and overgeneralizes (gen-006, gen-011) by at least 30%
